_how_to: Open-source developers page (/developers/), tools/developers.py. One row per person with public crypto-related code: at least one public, non-fork crypto repo of their own, or merged commits/pull requests in a public crypto project (Bitcoin, Nexa, Ethereum and other chains, wallets, Lightning, nodes, explorers, smart contracts, cryptographic protocols used in crypto). Unrelated open source does not count. notable: up to 3 items, kind 'contrib' (project, commits from the GitHub contributors API or GitLab, merged_prs from GitHub search) or kind 'repo' (own non-fork repo, stars, language at the check date). nordic_source: where the Nordic link is shown (the public GitHub location field unless noted). Only public professional information: no emails, no addresses, no private details. status 'pending' until the editor sets 'published' (review 'ready_for_owner': jQrgen decides). The public build shows only 'published' rows; --preview shows pending rows, marked. tools/check_dev_profiles.py re-checks the profiles against the public GitHub and GitLab APIs.
